1.consolidated_definition: Sentar cabeza, volverse más reflexivo y mejorar el comportamiento, a raíz de un aprendizaje basado en experiencias. “Ese muchacho no coge cabeza”. Responsable de choque fatal también estuvo involucrado en un accidente de four track en el que murió su novia. (Primera Hora, 18-09-12)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To gain a sense of responsibility, become more reflective and improve behavior as a result of experiential learning. "That young man has not gained his head." Also involved in a fatal crash, he was responsible for another four-track accident in which his girlfriend died. (First Hour, 18-09-12)
